newsitem.title: USA: Unisys seen on 'right track' - Barron's.
newsitem.headline: Unisys seen on 'right track' - Barron's.

text.p: Unisys Corp "is finally on the right track" following its latest of several restructurings, Barron's columnist Alan Abelson said in his "Up & Down Wall Street" column, citing a holder of the stock whom he identified as a "first-rate stockpicker".
The company's stock, which closed Thursday up 1/8, at 7-5/8, is also "a very decent speculation," Abelson wrote, citing the unnamed stockpicker.
The latest restructuring "appears to be yielding some tangible benefits," Abelson wrote, splitting the company's operations into three parts: computer hardware, maintenance and information services.
For fiscal 1997, the company "should earn around $0.40 per share and even show a little top-line growth," Abelson wrote.
